scenario.summary: A threat actor used SEO poisoning on Bing to deliver trojanized IT management installers, leading to Bumblebee and AdaptixC2 infections. The intrusion escalated to a full network compromise where the actor performed credential dumping, established persistent remote access via RustDesk, exfiltrated data, and ultimately deployed Akira ransomware.

meta.rationale: Start with servers, particularly backup and file servers, as these were targeted for data exfiltration and database credential dumping.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary has staged reconnaissance data in ProgramData, exfiltrated it via FileZilla/SFTP, and deployed Akira ransomware binaries (locker.exe/win.exe) for environment-wide encryption.

hunt.name: Akira Ransomware: Data Exfiltration and Impact
hunt.description: This hunt focuses on the final stages of the Bumblebee/AdaptixC2 attack chain. It investigates evidence of data staging (specifically 'shares.txt' in ProgramData), network exfiltration to identified attacker infrastructure using SFTP, and the presence of Akira ransomware payloads. By correlating file system artifacts, network connections, and rare process execution, this hunt identifies hosts where the impact is imminent or has already occurred.

config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%filezilla%' OR LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%filezilla%'
config.description: Identify hosts where FileZilla, the tool used for exfiltration in this campaign, has been installed.
config.expected_signal: Hosts with FileZilla installed. While legitimate in some contexts, installation on servers or by non-admins during a suspected incident is high signal.

primitive_config.label: Scope hosts with FileZilla installation
primitive_config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%filezilla%' OR LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE '%filezilla%'
primitive_config.expected: Hosts with FileZilla installed. While legitimate in some contexts, installation on servers or by non-admins during a suspected incident is high signal.

nodes.label: SFTP network exfiltration to identified IPs

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port, time FROM hb_network_connection WHERE instr(',' || '{{exfil_ips}}' || ',', ',' || dst_endpoint_ip || ',') > 0 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find network connections to the SFTP exfiltration servers identified in the research.
config.expected_signal: Connections to known bad IPs, likely associated with FileZilla or other SFTP clients.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, file_path, process_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{staging_paths}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_path) || ',') > 0 OR (LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%\programdata\%.txt' AND activity_id = 1)) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Detect the creation of the specific 'shares.txt' staging file or other suspicious file activity in ProgramData.
config.expected_signal: Creation of shares.txt or a sudden cluster of text files in ProgramData, indicative of reconnaissance staging.

primitive_config.label: Data staging in ProgramData
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, file_path, process_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{staging_paths}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_path) || ',') > 0 OR (LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%\programdata\%.txt' AND activity_id = 1)) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Creation of shares.txt or a sudden cluster of text files in ProgramData, indicative of reconnaissance staging.

nodes.label: Prevalence of Akira binaries and ProgramData processes

config.content: SELECT LOWER(process_path) AS path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{ransomware_binaries}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 OR (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%\programdata\%' AND LOWER(process_path) NOT LIKE '%\malwarebytes\%' AND LOWER(process_path) NOT LIKE '%\microsoft\%')) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY 1 HAVING hosts <= 3
config.description: Identify rare binaries matching Akira payload names or any process executing from ProgramData, which is a common staging ground.
config.expected_signal: Rare processes (seen on < 3 hosts) running from staging paths or matching Akira filenames like 'locker.exe'.
